# Try SqlClient’s new connection pool for faster parallel connections

## What Changed

You told us that applications using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient can take too long to establish the database connections they need. When many requests need connections at the same time, waiting for the connection pool to grow can delay application readiness and increase latency.
